provenance.note: The upstream package version (0.2.3) is NOT an identity marker. The Git commit e8384e087bd2f44eb05fc7ae1a3c525ea8244179 is the authoritative identity of the imported base. The vendor tree ships inside this repository and is installed with 'pip install -e vendor\voicemem'; no deployment path clones upstream.

embedding_policy.invariant: Every VoiceMem memory embedding operation routes through the explicitly injected local multilingual E5 (intfloat/multilingual-e5-small, 384-d, offline) or, when nothing is injected, the same local E5 via LocalE5Embedder. No memory embedding path may call a remote OpenAI embedding service, and no OpenAI Embeddings API fallback exists.

HU/EN relative-time cues in leftbrain/time_expand.py (word-boundary Latin regex, ISO date stamps) + multilingual date-value parsing (ISO/CJK/HU/EN) and value-level date-overlap bonus in local_memory_store.py + Hungarian temporal-question cues in _DATE_Q_RE (external audit v0.6.3 finding CD-3, P1)

recency ranking: exponentially decaying bonus on the event date (observed_at, 30-day half-life, weight 0.10) added to the left-brain hit sort key (base_score + recency_boost; supersession-first unchanged; undated legacy rows get 0) (external audit v0.6.3 finding CD-4, P1)

occurrence counting: explicit-NONE and omit-NONE resolutions with an exact (normalized) text match against an existing memory increment occurrence_count/last_observed_at via non-destructive metadata merge (Mem0BackendStore.count_occurrence + MemoryRepository facade + JSON mirror) (external audit v0.6.3 finding OCC-1, P2)

trait observation bookkeeping + confidence dynamics: additive first_seen/last_seen/occurrence_count columns on rb_traits (idempotent ALTER TABLE migration), merge-time occurrence increment + asymptotic confidence reinforcement c'=c+(1-c)*0.3, read-time decay (90-day grace, 180-day halflife, legacy rows unpunished), and a bounded confidence term in the trait ranking priority sim*(0.75+0.25*eff) (external audit v1.0 findings F-D + F-C remainder; hit metadata gains confidence/occurrence/first_seen/last_seen)

cold-memory archive wired + TTL read: ArchiveColdMemories now runs daily (kv-throttled 20h, archive_cold_last_run) on the post-Ingest maintenance thread - same pattern as the audio cleanup, non-destructive mem0 expiration archiving; heartnote TTL finally READ: session (1 day) / short_term (14 days) rows skipped at retrieval, rows never deleted (external audit finding F-G)

trait contradiction semantics (v0.9.0 memory semantics, measured-hazard fix): deterministic stance classification (voicemem/rightbrain/stance.py — EN/HU cue scanner, 0 LLM) gates the trait merge in traits_store.add; outcomes are now explicit — MERGE (same-stance agreement, threshold unchanged 0.95), SUPERSEDE (opposite pos/neg stance + similarity in the measured contradiction band >=0.90, or >=0.88 for presuppositional negation like 'no longer'/'gave up'/'már nem' + topic-token overlap + not a stale replay: new row becomes current, old row gains ONLY superseded_by/superseded_at — occurrence/confidence frozen, never reinforced), SEPARATE (qualified/past/uncertain/cross-stance or below-band: new independent node, deferred resolution). rb_traits gains additive idempotent columns stance/supersedes/superseded_by/superseded_at (legacy rows: stance inferred from claim text at decision time, never superseded). search_scored ranks active-first (superseded rows remain retrievable for historical queries but never outrank current — mirrors left-brain VM-LOCAL-008 ordering); _rb_trait_hits filters min-sim per-row, applies x0.75 demotion to superseded traits (heartnote convention) and surfaces stance/supersedes/superseded_by/superseded_at in hit metadata. app/retrieval_contract.py extends the v0.8.1 typed contract with the same keys and renders 'superseded' in the prompt suffix (fact-side wording). Evidence: docs/SEMANTIC_MATRIX.md (real local E5 measurements — antipathy 0.9685 / past 0.9821-0.9865 / qualified-HU 0.9552 / flip-back-HU 0.9521 all exceeded the 0.95 merge band pre-fix).
